title: [Lean] Certify all 144 selected helper-owner rows and per-call injections
body:
## Result and exact scope

At source-matched κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918, the finite certificate proves that each of the144 ordered rows has480 distinct helpers below14336 and outside its224-register active interval, and derives per-call borrowed-owner, ordinary704-register and tagged712-register family injection. It does not assert global disjointness across calls, actual physical projection/execution or the full multiplication theorem.

The proof covers every helper in the original ordered 144-by-480 table, not only call 0 or a sample. It uses the accepted split-data source, a generic sorted-owner certificate, 36 checked four-row blocks and one exhaustive join. The final declarations prove all rows certified, borrowed-owner injection and active-interval exclusion, ordinary 704-register injection and tagged 712-register family injection.

## Existing checked evidence

The exact final source is `53f3c474fe747eaa30c617361e33b68249da035a2666854e36f6caca95ebe6a1`, with independent terminal `558bd5aa49fa10a588226243c3344bc4dcbce67d7b3e1920e116f707b9717b20`. All 36 blocks and the final join are accepted. The rejected monolithic data/checker, call0-only pilot and unrelated source-only candidates are excluded. The original resource failures remain preserved in the research record.

The reproducible closure contains 45 exact Lean modules: 43 included sources (405,537 bytes) plus the two immutable public Stream/Realize prerequisites. `prepare_sources.py` reconstructs the latter with one declared import-line adjustment and checks every resulting source hash. The README and REPRODUCTION.json provide public Git fetches, the pinned Lean 4.21.0 / Mathlib `308445d7985027f538e281e18df29ca16ede2ba3` environment and serial module commands. The existing source-reconstruction check matches all 45 accepted hashes. No block, join or proof was rerun during packaging.

## Attribution and remaining suppliers

Prepared for James Chang with substantial OpenAI assistance. Credit Rohan Arun's PR1094 selected overlay; Jeremy Kothe's T16 construction; Hao Yan's retained lineage; columbia-git's PR1553 emitted owner binding; and DreamingOfClouds' PR509 Stream / PR516 Realize. Apache-2.0, full prerequisite notices and exact source provenance are preserved. No novelty is claimed for generic sorting or injection arguments.

The selected JSON-to-Lean literal correspondence is separately source-reviewed, rather than a verified parser theorem. Physical family projection, charts, event ordering, actual executor correspondence, cross-call scheduling and precision remain suppliers. The coherent Hosting prerequisite retains its explicit conditional hypotheses.

A current bounded duplicate search found no exact exhaustive-join module PR. PR1553 provides source-bound owner/program and input-majorant evidence; historical owner certificates and current finite packing proposals concern different source instances or interfaces. Those comparisons and their limits are retained. This is not a global novelty claim.

## CI and publication status

This is one coherent finite certificate chunk. Existing accepted source bytes and historical receipts are preserved. No candidate-specific CI or relocated full-closure replay has been run before submission. CI will be inspected after publication; generic repository checks alone do not demonstrate that these Lean certificates were replayed.
